type Conflict<T> = T extends [
  infer U,
  infer U extends string,
  infer U extends number,
] ? U : never;
type AnyConflict<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends any,
  infer U
] ? U : never;
type AnyBoth<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends any,
  infer U extends any
] ? U : never;
type Equivalent<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends string | number,
  infer U extends number | string,
] ? U : never;
type Literal<T> = T extends [infer U, infer U extends 'a'] ? U : never;
const negative: Literal<[1, 'a']> = 1;
